summary: Shell research program phase 3: one opus agent reads the 7 audits + 5 scouts + frame and writes the prioritised topic map, decides the artifact set, and commissions wave 2 with wave 3 staged
logs: Map: 237 rows · wave2 13 dives in 7 groups · wave3 staged 8 · deferred 27 · owner questions 8 · frame corrections 25

conflicts_resolved: 1. set -e vs explicit checks: by script kind. Repo/CI bash keeps set -euo pipefail as a net, with check-set-e-suppressed and check-extra-masked-returns mandatory; sh uses set -eu plus probed pipefail; installers use set -u plus explicit || die (rustup model); sourced libraries set no options. Evidence: [fail] s9/s10, [fleet] #9, [ex].

2. POSIX sh vs bash: by kind. Installers, bootstrap and login snippets are #!/bin/sh. Repo, CI and test tools are #!/usr/bin/env bash with a bash 3.2 floor unless the header names a pinned interpreter. A raised floor needs a BASH_VERSINFO guard. Libraries carry a shellcheck shell= directive. H1 refuted (0/190) [fleet] #6.

3. POSIX.1-2024 per feature for #!/bin/sh. pipefail: probe only, never set -o pipefail ||. Dollar-single-quote and read -d: never. find -print0 and xargs -0: use. xargs -r, realpath, readlink -f: Linux only. timeout: probe. test -nt/-ot/-ef: use. test -a/-o: never. Measured beats canonical: Debian dash 0.5.12-12 accepts pipefail, while 0.5.12-2 and -6ubuntu5 do not [shift] s3, [plat].

4. ShellCheck: curated set at default severity. -o all rejected. Fleet -S warning overturned because it hides info-level SC2086/2046/2068/2162. Enabled: check-set-e-suppressed, check-extra-masked-returns, deprecate-which, external-sources=true, source-path=SCRIPTDIR. Relax only with a reason: SC2317/2329 (handlers), SC1091, SC2016, SC3040 (probed pipefail), SC3043 (local, no ksh93). Never relax: SC2086, 2046, 2068, 2155, 2164, 2162, 2115.
5. shfmt style of record: -i 4 -ci written to .editorconfig; the gate passes no style flags, because flags override EditorConfig (fleet 161/197 clean; owner Q3).

6. PowerShell: installers and bootstrap target 5.1; repo/dev/CI target 7.6 LTS (7.4/7.5 EOS 2026-11-10); modules are dual-edition. PSSA: Severity Error,Warning, PSUseCompatibleSyntax TargetVersions per kind, exclusions per kind not global. Parsing on the real 5.1 host is the second gate.

7. Two rules: shell-quality (sh/bash/zsh/ksh/fish/nu/elvish/bats plus CI YAML) with per-shell depth files, and powershell-quality. No third rule for fish/nu/elvish. Extensionless scripts get three things: an extension SHOULD, gate discovery via shfmt -f/--detect, and skill descriptions; no shebang glob exists ([cfg] s2.4).

8. GHA run: blocks and Taskfile cmds belong to this set and are globbed: .github/workflows/*.yml|yaml, action.yml|yaml, Taskfile.yml, taskfile.yml, *.taskfile.yml. Per 'Narrow the Glob Only When It Cannot Miss', a pointer-only route would miss every run: edit. If a CI set appears, ci.md moves there.
10. macOS /bin/sh is bash 3.2 in POSIX mode (Apple, normative, read only), not dash as fleet quality-bash.md asserts.
13. local in #!/bin/sh: allowed when ksh93 is not a target, with a reasoned SC3043 directive. Installers keep the has_local probe.
14. Shebang: #!/usr/bin/env bash, plus a BASH_VERSINFO guard above the 3.2 floor. #!/bin/bash is not a defect for an intended 3.2 floor.
15. Exit vocabulary by kind: shell CLIs mirror the rust cli-contract table, installers keep 0-7; both document that a TERM-killed child reads 143/271/399 depending on the shell (owner Q6).
16. elvish -compileonly exists and works on 0.21.0 (55/55 planted errors); [ocx] was wrong. nu-check always exits 0, so the nu gate needs a nu --ide-check wrapper.
17. Frame vs audit counts: [fleet] authored counts are used (deduped), [cfg] for raw counts; both overturn the frame's ~1100/~1450.
18. SIGPIPE under pipefail: SH-ERR generalises CMK-CORE-05 to all shell scripts, with a sibling pointer; grep check until SC2337 ships.
19. echo vs printf: echo only for fixed literals with no leading dash and no backslash; printf '%s\n' otherwise (4/8 shells interpret backslash-t in plain echo).
20. The bash 3.2 floor is enforced by a grep denylist plus bash -n and a run on the bash:3.2 image, because ShellCheck has no bash-version target (koalaman/shellcheck#2615 open).
21. nix-flake-adopt says bash --noprofile --norc -eo pipefail is 'the shell GHA uses'; that is true only for shell: bash (unspecified is bash -e {0}). Reported as sibling defect M-X-04.
22. The Windows host verification grant (frame Q4) stands, staged only under C:/Users/ecom/shell-wintest.

artifact_set.rationale: PowerShell is a separate language: different gate (PSSA plus a 5.1 parse), error model, encoding problem and glob, so it gets its own rule. Everything POSIX-family plus fish/nu/elvish shares one index. Per-shell depth files are routed by task, because the fleet has only 3 authored alt-shell files and most alt-shell risk is emitted code that only the shell-integration skill reaches. Globs widen to workflows, composite actions and Taskfiles: they hold the largest fleet shell surface (628 run: blocks, 954 cmds) and the one confirmed injection, and no catalog rule covers run: semantics. Extensionless scripts cannot be globbed, so they are covered by an extension SHOULD, gate discovery via shfmt -f, and skill descriptions. There is one ID family per depth file or index (22). Skills carry procedures only; standards live in the rules. Out of scope: interactive-shell config guides, csh/tcsh, cmd.exe batch, Makefile/Dockerfile shell, full alt-shell style guides, and fixing ocx/www-setup/upstream emitters.
